# Baholo Projects

> Baholo Projects (Pty) Ltd, also known as Baholo, is an industrial services company based in Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa. Tshegofatso Goitseone Moleko founded it in 2016, and the company was formally registered in 2019. It is a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor.

## Industrial services

- [Industrial supply and procurement](https://www.baholoprojects.co.za/#industrial-supplies): Pipes, fittings, flanges, valves, pumps, fasteners, steel, welding consumables, instrumentation and other industrial equipment.
- [Welding and fabrication](https://www.baholoprojects.co.za/#welding-fabrication): Stainless and carbon steel fabrication, industrial components, pipework, equipment modifications and repairs.
- [Pipework and installation](https://www.baholoprojects.co.za/#pipework): Pipe preparation and fitting, valves, flanges, supports, tie-ins and maintenance.
- [Scaffolding services](https://www.baholoprojects.co.za/#scaffolding): Erection and dismantling of temporary access scaffolding for industrial work.
- [Industrial consulting and project support](https://www.baholoprojects.co.za/#industrial-consulting): Requirements assessment, material identification, procurement and coordination of fabrication and installation.

## Company and enquiries

- [About Baholo Projects](https://www.baholoprojects.co.za/#about): Company history and experience, including previous work with Heineken.
- [How Baholo works](https://www.baholoprojects.co.za/#approach): Understand the requirement, plan, quote, deliver and hand over.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.baholoprojects.co.za/#faq): Service scope, combined supply and installation, site coverage and quoting.
- [Request a quote](https://www.baholoprojects.co.za/#contact): Share the site location, what you need, specifications and timing. Call +27 67 616 8687 or email info@baholoprojects.co.za. Enquiry hours are Monday to Friday, 08:00–16:00 SAST.
